query:
insert into decision_amendments (id, decision_id, body, author_user, author_agent)
               select $1, d.id, $3, $4, $5
               from decisions d
               join projects p on p.id = d.project_id
               where d.id = $2
                 and ($6::uuid is null or group_visible(p.group_id, $6))
               returning id
